headline: WNBA Finals Game 1: Valkyries host the Dream at Chase Center
whyCareReason: Both semifinals ended 3-0. Game 1 is Saturday 17 October at 3:30 p.m. ET on NBC. No score yet.
teaser: Golden State host Atlanta at Chase Center. Dream won the Liberty series 85-83 in the clincher. Valkyries won the Aces series 87-77 in overtime.
story: The 2026 WNBA Finals open Saturday 17 October at Chase Center in San Francisco. ESPN and the Valkyries list Game 1 at 3:30 p.m. ET (12:30 p.m. PT) on NBC and Peacock. Golden State are the higher seed and host Games 1 and 2. Atlanta swept the Liberty 3-0, closing 85-83, with Angel Reese scoring 22 points. Golden State swept the defending champion Aces 3-0, closing 87-77 in overtime at Michelob ULTRA Arena. The Valkyries are in their second season. The match stays upcoming.
stakes: Game 1 is the first game of a best-of-seven. Golden State host. Atlanta host Games 3 and 4.
rivalryAngle: A second-year expansion team against a club in the Finals for the first time since 2013.
funFacts: Series: Dream swept Liberty 3-0. Valkyries swept Aces 3-0.
Game 1 is Saturday 17 October, 3:30 p.m. ET, Chase Center, NBC and Peacock.
